title: SemanticStep
description: A semantic action record built on top of primitive execution traces. It preserves the underlying primitive span while optionally attaching a fragment_op as the high-level semantic interpretation.

semantic_step_id.description: Stable identifier of the semantic step within a dataset or replay trace.

semantic_level.description: Whether the semantic step was cleanly resolved to a fragment action, or had to fall back to an atomic/primitive interpretation.

primitive_span.description: Inclusive [start_idx, end_idx] span into the primitive execution trace that this semantic step covers. Null is allowed for legacy/bootstrap records where the primitive span is unavailable.

primitive_ops.description: Primitive operation dicts covered by this semantic step. The exact primitive-op schema is intentionally left flexible because the project still has multiple legacy operation dialects.

fragment_op.description: High-level fragment action when the semantic step is resolved at fragment level. Null for atomic_fallback records.

annotation_confidence.description: Confidence score in [0,1] for the semantic interpretation. Null is allowed when confidence is unavailable.

source.description: Primary generation source inherited from the underlying fragment/action extraction logic.

generator.description: Code path or tool that generated the semantic_step record.

annotation_method.description: Human-readable name of the semantic annotation method.

source_record_id.description: Optional upstream pair/path identifier used to trace the semantic step back to its source record.

confidence.description: Optional duplicate of annotation confidence for downstream systems that only inspect provenance.

actionlib_version.description: Version of the action library or semantic annotation logic that produced this record.

notes.description: Optional notes, fallback reason, diff_type, or error hint.
